structure GradeZeroPart (V : Space E ι ε) (V'' : Space E _ ε'') (wt : ι → ℤ) where

def GradeZeroPart.splitting (Z : GradeZeroPart V V'' w) : V.Splitting V'' {i // 0 < w i} :=
  have := congr((fun M ↦ (trace M, M * V.J⁻¹)) (V.J⁻¹ * $(show diagonal (if 0 < w · then 1 else 0) *
    V.J = V.J * diagonal fun i ↦ 1 - ite (0 < w i) 1 0 - ite (w i = 0) 1 0 by simp; grind
    [GradeZeroPart])))
  by use inclMatrix E (↑), V.J⁻¹ * inclMatrix E (@Subtype.val ι _), Z.incl <;> simp [↓gram_incl,
    Matrix.mul_assoc, Z.mem_range_index, V.isHermitian_J.inv.eq, ← @Nat.cast_inj E,
    ← Fintype.card_range Z.index, trace_mul_comm] at * <;>
    grind [GradeZeroPart, incl_eq_zero, star_zero, Fintype.sum_eq_zero]

structure ArrowPair where
  zeroPart : GradeZeroPart (flipSum V V'') (hypSum q (flipSum (stdSpace E X) (stdSpace E X'')))
    (Y.gradeOf ⊕ᵥ Y''.gradeOf)
  string_spec : Odd s ∧ s' = s - 1 ∧ s'' = s' - 1 ∧ Y'.c = Y.c
  even_card_add : Even (Fintype.card ι + Fintype.card ι'')
  embX : G (n := X₀) E 1 →* G (n := X'') E 1
  det_embX k : (embX k).det = k.det
  intertwines g k : fromBlocks (V.ratCoordMatrix (Y.inclX g)) 0 0
    (V''.ratCoordMatrix (Y''.inclX k)) * zeroPart.incl.map toAdele =
    zeroPart.incl.map toAdele * (G.sum (s := hypSigns q) (1, .sum (g.neg, embX k))).mat
  gradeOne : q ↪ {l // Y'.gradeOf l = 1}
  stackedT_apply a l : stackedT Y Y' Y'' (zeroPart.index a) l = ∑ k,
    ite (l = gradeOne k) ↑(zeroPart.incl (zeroPart.index a) (.inl (.inr k)) * Y'.c) 0

gradedLatticeBasis.name: gradedLatticeBasis
gradedLatticeBasis.statement:
noncomputable def gradedLatticeBasis {R X' ι : Type*} {s} [CommRing R] [StarRing R] (e :
  (X' ⊕ Unit) ⊕ Fin s ≃ ι) (a π : Rˣ) (u : unitary R) := reindex e e (fromBlocks (ite (Odd s)
  (diagonal (1 ⊕ᵥ fun _ ↦ (star π)⁻¹.1)) 1) 0 (of fun b ↦ 0 ⊕ᵥ fun _ ↦ ite (b = b.rev)
  (u * (star π * π)⁻¹.1) 0) (diagonal fun b ↦ u * ite (Odd s) 1 (ite (2 * b < s) a⁻¹.1 (star a))))

  integral x : d * r x ∈ integralAway n
  size_le : p → ∀ σ : ℂ ≃+* ℂ, r.sum (fun _ ↦ (‖σ ·‖)) ≤ B

  g *ᵥ (x + y) ∈ A) (hc : (d : ℕ) * (c / ‖finMultiplier g‖ ^ 2) ∈ integralAway q) (hp : p →
  ∀ σ : ℂ ≃+* ℂ, ‖σ c‖ ≤ 1) : IsAdmissibleComb (C • V.finHeisOp
  · V.vacElem) A q d p 1 (V.ω (1, g) (V.finHeisOp x V.vacElem))

inBesselMean.name: Grading.integral_besselMeasure_eq_of_mean
inBesselMean.statement:
lemma integral_besselMeasure_eq_of_mean {q} [Fintype q] (v : q ↪ {l // Y.gradeOf l = 1}) :
  let row n (p : q × X) := Y.c * (V.ratCoordMatrix n - 1) (v p.1) (Y.indexEquiv (.inl p.2))
  ∃ κ, ∀ {φ} {f : _ → _ → ℂ} {M}, Y.ratBessel.FixesLeft φ → Continuous φ → (∀ᵉ (n ∈ Y.unipotent)
    (a), φ (n * Y.inclX a) = f a (row n)) → (∀ a, IsContPeriodic (_root_.ratVectors ..) (f a) ∧
    quotMean (_root_.ratVectors ..) (f a) = M a) → Continuous M → (stdSpace ..).Γ.FixesLeft M → ∫ r,
    φ r ∂Y.besselMeasure = κ * ∫ a, M a ∂(stdSpace ..).quotMeasure

lemma IsGeneric.unipotent_mul_constTerm (hP : Y.IsGeneric P) {u w} (hu : u ∈ Y.unipotent) (h₁ :
  HasDegreeGe Y.gradeOf Y.gradeOf 2 (V.ratCoordMatrix u - 1)) (h₂ : HasDegreeGe d Y.gradeOf 1 (w *
  (V.ratCoordMatrix u - 1))) x g h : P (u * x) * Y.constTerm d (twistedPairWeil α (u * g, h) f) w
  = V.homBicharacter V' (Y.stringMap Y' * V.ratCoordMatrix u) (Y.stringMap Y') / V.homBicharacter V'
  (w * V.ratCoordMatrix u) w * (P x * Y.constTerm d (twistedPairWeil α (g, h)
  f) w)
